components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main download or completion action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: white; padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 560 14px/1.4 sans-serif; transition: background 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.3 0 0); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.623 0.214 259); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: white; color: oklch(0.205 0 0); padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0 0); border-radius: 6px; font: 560 14px/1.4 sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms, background 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); border-color: oklch(0.72 0 0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.623 0.214 259); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A compact navigation bar that appears after the opening scene.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 12px 16px; background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font: 560 14px/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: oklch(0.37 0 0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: oklch(0.623 0.214 259); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.623 0.214 259); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Chip

narrative.overview: A precise desktop instrument in a bright working environment. Visitors see speech move through recognition, conservative refinement, spelling normalization, and delivery before reading a marketing claim.
keyCharacteristics: Pure neutral surfaces with blue reserved for action and progress.
Compact desktop controls inside spacious page compositions.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue may occupy no more than ten percent of a typical viewport. Green is never decorative.

rules.name: The Chinese First Rule
rules.body: Chinese line breaks must be read as designed, not as an afterthought to an English layout.

rules.name: The One Window Rule
rules.body: Only the product demonstration may look like a floating application window.

dos: Do make the actual dictation pipeline the first-viewport signal.
Do use the formal Saymore mark and real product capability boundaries.
Do label development benchmarks as development benchmarks.
Do say source-available and link to PolyForm Shield 1.0.0.
donts: Don't build a generic AI SaaS landing page from repeated rounded cards, purple gradients, or inflated claims.
Don't imply screen reading, reply generation, task execution, or automatic sending.
Don't visually clone Typeless, Shandianshuo, Type-X, or any single competitor.
Don't fabricate performance metrics, app compatibility, testimonials, prices, or release availability.
